name: Arena Shift
description: One arena, one simulation, two Pocket Works generations. Switch live between Classic and Forge rendering while the same fight continues.
changelog: Fixes iPhone/Safari startup stalls by moving the Godot Web runtime to the Safari-safe chunked WASM production transport.
Refreshes the app cache namespace so devices do not keep serving the previous 1.0.0 Godot loader.
Gameplay, saves and the Classic/Forge shared simulation remain unchanged.
